crazing.name: crazing
crazing.definition: Network of fine, interconnected micro-surface fissures in the surface oxide or metal skin.
crazing.visual_look: Web-like, mosaic, or spider-web pattern of shallow hairline fissures on the steel finish.
crazing.cause: Extreme thermal shock during rapid water quench, uneven cooling rates, or excessive surface residual tensile stress.
crazing.typical_cause: Extreme thermal shock during rapid water quench, uneven cooling rates, or excessive surface residual tensile stress.
crazing.risk: Micro-cracks act as stress concentrations that rapidly propagate under cyclic dynamic load, causing catastrophic fatigue fracture.
crazing.action: Lower quench cooling gradient; verify annealing furnace temperature uniformity; relieve surface tensile residual stress.
crazing.recommended_action: Lower quench cooling gradient; verify annealing furnace temperature uniformity; relieve surface tensile residual stress.

inclusion.name: inclusion
inclusion.definition: Non-metallic solid foreign matter, entrapped slag particles, or deoxidation oxides within the metal matrix.
inclusion.visual_look: Dark, granular, or glassy irregular spots, clusters, or streaks contrasting sharply with the substrate.
inclusion.cause: Tundish or ladle refractory lining erosion, re-oxidation during molten steel pouring, or entrained mold flux powder.
inclusion.typical_cause: Tundish or ladle refractory lining erosion, re-oxidation during molten steel pouring, or entrained mold flux powder.
inclusion.risk: Discontinuities trigger localized stress risers, inducing laminar tearing, internal void growth, and rupture during stamping.
inclusion.action: Inspect tundish argon gas shrouding; purge ladle slag; replace worn submerged entry nozzles; verify tundish cleanliness.
inclusion.recommended_action: Inspect tundish argon gas shrouding; purge ladle slag; replace worn submerged entry nozzles; verify tundish cleanliness.

patches.name: patches
patches.definition: Localized superficial surface tears, roll adhesion marks, or oxide crust accumulation on the sheet.
patches.visual_look: Discontinuous rough darkened or textured patches, irregular scabs, and localized metal build-up.
patches.cause: Work roll surface spalling or wear, excessive mill chatter, roll lubrication breakdown, or localized pass reduction imbalance.
patches.typical_cause: Work roll surface spalling or wear, excessive mill chatter, roll lubrication breakdown, or localized pass reduction imbalance.
patches.risk: Degrades zinc galvanic coating and paint adhesion; creates surface roughness and cosmetic rejection in visible panels.
patches.action: Regrind or replace work rolls; balance mill roll-bending hydraulic pressure; optimize cooling lubricant emulsion delivery.
patches.recommended_action: Regrind or replace work rolls; balance mill roll-bending hydraulic pressure; optimize cooling lubricant emulsion delivery.

pitted_surface.name: pitted_surface
pitted_surface.definition: Dense localized micropores, cavity depressions, or pinhole indentations across the metal surface.
pitted_surface.visual_look: Mottled, rough cratered surface covered with dense pinholes, cavities, or localized chemical corrosion pockets.
pitted_surface.cause: Over-pickling acid corrosion attacking grain boundaries, cavitation erosion, or mechanical impression from pitted work rolls.
pitted_surface.typical_cause: Over-pickling acid corrosion attacking grain boundaries, cavitation erosion, or mechanical impression from pitted work rolls.
pitted_surface.risk: Accelerates localized crevice and pitting corrosion; degrades seal mating surfaces and decreases structural fatigue limit.
pitted_surface.action: Reduce pickling bath acid concentration and bath temperature; increase line speed; inspect and redress pitted rolls.
pitted_surface.recommended_action: Reduce pickling bath acid concentration and bath temperature; increase line speed; inspect and redress pitted rolls.

rolled_in_scale.name: rolled_in_scale
rolled_in_scale.definition: Iron oxide mill scale mechanically pressed and embedded into the steel substrate during hot or cold rolling passes.
rolled_in_scale.visual_look: Dark bluish or black fish-scale streaks, embedded elongated bands, or flaked trails aligned with rolling direction.
rolled_in_scale.cause: Deficient high-pressure descaling header pressure, clogged water descaling spray nozzles, or furnace atmosphere control failure.
rolled_in_scale.typical_cause: Deficient high-pressure descaling header pressure, clogged water descaling spray nozzles, or furnace atmosphere control failure.
rolled_in_scale.risk: Causes subsequent surface delamination, seam weld porosity, poor electroplating bond, and subsurface blisters during forming.
rolled_in_scale.action: Clean high-pressure descaling nozzles; maintain descaling water pressure at minimum 150 bar; balance roughing mill blowers.
rolled_in_scale.recommended_action: Clean high-pressure descaling nozzles; maintain descaling water pressure at minimum 150 bar; balance roughing mill blowers.

scratches.name: scratches
scratches.definition: Linear abrasive furrows or mechanical gouges scored into the metallic surface by dragging contact.
scratches.visual_look: Straight, elongated continuous or intermittent reflective grooves and sharp score marks parallel to strip movement.
scratches.cause: Mechanical friction against misaligned or worn entry guide shoes, foreign abrasive debris on table rollers, or handling slips.
scratches.typical_cause: Mechanical friction against misaligned or worn entry guide shoes, foreign abrasive debris on table rollers, or handling slips.
scratches.risk: Linear stress concentration grooves act as sharp notch initiators, inducing tearing during deep drawing and stamping operations.
scratches.action: Inspect and polish conveyor guide shoes; clean and replace damaged roller bearings; calibrate strip tension control.
scratches.recommended_action: Inspect and polish conveyor guide shoes; clean and replace damaged roller bearings; calibrate strip tension control.

unclassified_anomaly.name: unclassified_anomaly
unclassified_anomaly.definition: Surface texture or structural anomaly deviating from nominal baseline that does not match standard NEU-DET training classes.
unclassified_anomaly.visual_look: Atypical contrast variance, localized geometric discoloration, fluid stains, or novel texture discrepancies.
unclassified_anomaly.cause: Foreign lubricant contamination, electrical/tooling contact burns, out-of-domain metallurgical flaw, or novel tooling failure.
unclassified_anomaly.typical_cause: Foreign lubricant contamination, electrical/tooling contact burns, out-of-domain metallurgical flaw, or novel tooling failure.
unclassified_anomaly.risk: Unknown mechanical defect escape; potential violation of surface roughness and critical dimensional tolerances.
unclassified_anomaly.action: Quarantine component for human QA inspection; execute SEM/EDX metallurgical review and optical surface profilometry.
unclassified_anomaly.recommended_action: Quarantine component for human QA inspection; execute SEM/EDX metallurgical review and optical surface profilometry.
